content.short: WeaveDB is a fully decentralized NoSQL database as a smart contract on Arweave.
content.description: WeaveDB provides a horizontally scalable database designed to grow with your data and traffic. As a decentralized solution, it reduces the risk of a single point of failure that often impacts traditional databases. The architecture prioritizes low latency, enabling fast, responsive database operations even as load increases. Beyond storage, it offers a broad set of developer tools and APIs to help build fully decentralized applications, covering data modeling, querying, and integration.
